description: Alert raise/clear sequences through the airspace monitor. Each case is a list of steps on one monitor: observe (one aircraft message at wall time t_s), tick (no message), switch_source (U-15). expected.per_step[i] lists what step i raised and cleared (with the clear reason: resolved, stale, source_disabled, landed). Aircraft fields: id, lat_deg/lon_deg (computed; north_m/east_m are how the case was built), alt_amsl_m (default 550), vn/ve/vd (m/s, vd down), flying (default true: armed for relay, airborne for Remote ID), captured_at_s (default t_s; the ingest's placement), rx_at_s (default captured_at_s), station_clock_offset_s (the station's own ts = captured_at_s + offset; default 0), backlog, source (relay | remote_id), station, alt_source, identification, transmitter, identified. An absent alt_source is geodetic: a vertical position, judged against the vertical minimum (utm read every altitude but 'pressure' that way). Policy 60 s / 60 m / 20 m / 800 m; defaults clear_after_s 3, stale_after_s 15, neighbour_max_age_s 10, live_max_age_s 10, pressure_uncertainty_m 250, ahead_tolerance_s 1, max_aircraft 50000, max_source_share 0.5. The source key of max_source_share is (source, station). Zones are ED-269 features. counters lists the counts the case pins; a refused sample is counted under its reason (rejected_older_than_held, rejected_placed_ahead, rejected_capacity, rejected_source_share, the last two also per source as <counter>/<source>/<station>) and judges nothing.

units.t_s: seconds, epoch, the monitor's wall clock

generated: Expected values computed by knowledge/tools/gen_vectors.py, which runs the old Python implementation (rootxkit/utm @ 484cd228035f) on these inputs. Regenerate rather than edit.
hysteresis_rule: cleared resolved when (last time shown false) - (last time shown true) > clear_after_s; a message that could not judge a pair or zone neither refreshes nor shows false

cases.name: head-on-raises-one-critical
cases.why: A raise names both aircraft once; t_cpa 25 s.

cases.name: raised-once-not-every-tick
cases.why: An alert is raised once per condition and refreshed silently while true.

cases.name: resolved-after-hysteresis
cases.why: Shown false from 1.0 s; cleared 'resolved' only once shown false for MORE than clear_after_s since last true (0 s): at 3.5 s, not 3.0 s.

cases.name: silence-does-not-clear-before-stale
cases.why: No message shows the pair apart, so the alert stays.

cases.name: silent-aircraft-cleared-stale-by-tick
cases.why: The end of a condition can be the ABSENCE of telemetry: a tick with no message must drop stale aircraft (>15 s) and clear with reason stale, not resolved.

cases.name: on-the-ground-raises-nothing
cases.why: Disarmed aircraft at a base are routinely metres apart; alerting would teach operators to ignore alerts.

cases.name: disarming-clears-as-landed
cases.why: C-14: a disarmed aircraft leaves the picture and its conflict clears with reason landed. utm cleared it as stale (S-25), which reads as 'we lost it' when the aircraft is known to be on the ground.
cases.decision: A disarm or landing clears as landed (LESSONS C-14, PLAN section 11 gap 4, uspace-core PR #15, owner decision). utm cleared it as stale.

cases.name: hovering-inside-minima-stays-alerted
cases.why: SITL 2026-09-29: 29.9 m apart hovering with velocity noise. Raised once and never cleared as resolved while they stay.

cases.name: hovering-outside-minima-raises-nothing
cases.why: The absence pair at 80 m.

cases.name: diverging-clears-resolved-once-past-minimum
cases.why: Opening at 5 m/s from 40 m: inside until t=3 (55 m), shown clear from t=4 (60 m), cleared at t=7 (more than 3 s after last true).

cases.name: silent-neighbour-ends-stale-never-resolved
cases.why: B goes silent, A keeps reporting (and A flies through B's last position). Once B's sample is more than 10 s old the pair cannot be judged: neither refreshed nor shown clear. It ends when B is dropped (t=16) with reason stale. Without this rule A's own messages 'resolved' a conflict with an aircraft nobody could see.

cases.name: reporting-neighbour-can-resolve
cases.why: The presence pair: B reports, diverging, and it resolves.

cases.name: evidence-outranks-stale
cases.why: When an alert is both shown false for longer than the hysteresis and one aircraft just went stale, the reason is resolved: evidence outranks silence.

cases.name: backlog-raises-nothing-then-live-alerts
cases.why: Records the ingest flagged as backlog (queued before the session that delivered them, or delivered while draining) are history: counted, recorded, never alerted. Live records alert again.

cases.name: late-delivery-not-evaluated
cases.why: live_max_age_s applies to wall - rx_ts (ingest-to-monitor leg only): 15 s late is rejected as late, counted, not alerted.

cases.name: station-clock-skew-costs-no-alert
cases.why: A's station clock is an hour behind, B's a day ahead. Placement uses the ingest's clock (captured_at derived from rx_ts), so a station clock wrong by any amount still raises. (The station's own `ts` is used only to order samples within one source.)

cases.name: out-of-order-sample-ignored
cases.why: Within one source, a sample older on that station's clock than the one held, and not received later, is out of order: counted and ignored. Samples from different sources are never ordered against each other.

cases.name: source-disabled-clears-with-its-own-reason
cases.why: U-15: switching Remote ID off drops its aircraft at once and clears with reason source_disabled (neither resolved: nothing showed it false; nor stale: it was deliberately removed). While off its messages are counted, not judged. On again, the next message raises again.

cases.name: one-station-off-drops-only-its-aircraft
cases.why: An instance switch touches only that instance's tracks.

cases.name: zone-enter-and-leave
cases.why: Entering raises once; leaving clears as resolved after the hysteresis (last true 2.0 s, cleared at 6.5 s, not 5.0 s).

cases.name: zone-stops-applying-clears
cases.why: Applicability is judged at the placed time in UTC. The window ends while the aircraft sits inside; the alert clears resolved.

cases.name: applicability-at-placed-time-not-arrival
cases.why: Captured inside the window, judged 5 s later after it ended: the aircraft WAS in the zone while it applied.

cases.name: severity-change-is-raised-again
cases.why: S-33: on pressure altitude, inside the band is critical, inside only the band widened by 250 m is warning. A severity change is raised again under the same key, never changed silently in place.

cases.name: unidentified-in-prohibited-zone-raises-identification
cases.why: U-02: an unidentified or unknown_operator aircraft inside PROHIBITED or REQ_AUTHORISATION raises 'identification' beside the zone alert: the incident seam. Both clear together.

cases.name: mismatch-raised-on-the-ground-too
cases.why: identification_mismatch is about who, not where: judged on every live message, on the ground and without an altitude too.

cases.name: backlog-raises-no-mismatch
cases.why: History raises no identity alert either.

cases.name: unidentified-and-serial-of-same-transmitter-never-pair
cases.why: S-32: one radio under two ids (unidentified, then its serial) must not conflict with itself.

cases.name: two-serials-on-one-transmitter-do-pair
cases.why: Two identified tracks on one address are two claims (a spoofer on its victim's address among them): judged like any pair.

cases.name: older-placement-from-another-station-is-refused
cases.why: T-13: B, held at 1 s, is heard through another station placed at -5 s, far away. utm took it and rewound B's track to -5 s, so the tick at 14 s dropped B as stale and cleared the conflict, though B was heard at 1 s. Refused and counted; the conflict stands.
cases.decision: A sample placed before the aircraft's latest one, from any source, is refused (rejected_older_than_held) and judges nothing (LESSONS T-06, T-13; uspace-core PR #15 review). utm took it from another station and rewound the track.

cases.name: placement-ahead-of-tolerance-is-refused
cases.why: T-13: a clear sample placed 5 s ahead of its own receipt (more than ahead_tolerance_s, 1 s). utm took it: the pair was shown clear at 6 s, more than the hysteresis after the last true reading, and the conflict resolved at once; the real sample at 2 s did not raise it again. Refused and counted; the real sample at 2 s still refreshes the conflict.
cases.decision: A sample placed ahead of its receipt, or received ahead of the wall clock, by more than ahead_tolerance_s is refused (rejected_placed_ahead) and buys no hysteresis (LESSONS T-13; uspace-core PR #15 review). utm took it.

cases.name: placement-within-ahead-tolerance-is-admitted
cases.why: T-13, the presence twin: placed exactly ahead_tolerance_s (1.0 s) ahead of its receipt is still admitted and refreshes the conflict. The tolerance absorbs clock jitter; only more than it is refused.

cases.name: eviction-order-not-flying-first-and-the-evicted-is-gone
cases.why: C-18: at the cap of 4 (A and B in conflict, C flying, D on the ground), E evicts D: an aircraft not flying goes first, although C was heard earlier. C's next sample is of an aircraft still held, so it evicts nothing. D's next sample is a new id, so D was gone: it evicts E, now the least recently heard aircraft without an alert. aircraft_evicted is 2; evicting C first would make it 3, and D still held would make it 1. The conflict is never touched.
cases.decision: Past max_aircraft only an aircraft without an active alert is evicted, and a new id is refused (rejected_capacity) when every aircraft held has one; eviction never clears an alert (LESSONS C-18; uspace-core PR #15 review). utm held every aircraft it heard.

cases.name: full-of-alert-holders-refuses-new-ids
cases.why: C-18: the cap of 2 is held by A and B, both in conflict. A new id is refused and counted, per source too; nothing is evicted, so a flood of new ids can never clear a real conflict.
cases.decision: Past max_aircraft only an aircraft without an active alert is evicted, and a new id is refused (rejected_capacity) when every aircraft held has one; eviction never clears an alert (LESSONS C-18; uspace-core PR #15 review). utm held every aircraft it heard.

cases.name: source-share-refuses-a-flooding-source
cases.why: C-18: receiver rx-1 already holds 2 aircraft with an alert, its share (0.5 of 4). A new id from it is refused (rejected_source_share), so one receiver flooding alert-raising ids cannot take the whole cap. Another source is still judged: D from a relay raises its conflict with A.
cases.decision: A new id is refused while its source holds max_source_share of max_aircraft in alert-holding aircraft (LESSONS C-18; uspace-core PR #15 review). utm had no cap and no share.

cases.name: source-share-counts-alert-holders-only
cases.why: C-18, the twin of source-share-refuses-a-flooding-source: rx-1 holds two aircraft, as many as its share, but neither has an alert. The share counts alert holders only, so a third id from rx-1 is admitted, judged, and raises its conflict with A.
